examples.q: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees get?
examples.a: Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. [leave-policy.pdf p.1] Up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried over into the next year. [leave-policy.pdf p.1]

examples.q: When do carried-over leave days expire?
examples.a: Up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried over into the next year. [leave-policy.pdf p.1] Carried-over days expire on 31 March. [leave-policy.pdf p.1]

examples.q: After how many consecutive sick days is a doctor's note required?
examples.a: A doctor's note is required for absences longer than 3 consecutive days. [leave-policy.pdf p.2]

examples.q: How many weeks of paid parental leave do secondary caregivers receive?
examples.a: Secondary caregivers receive 6 weeks of paid parental leave. [leave-policy.pdf p.2] Primary caregivers receive 26 weeks of paid parental leave. [leave-policy.pdf p.2]

examples.q: Within how many days must expense claims be submitted?
examples.a: Expense claims must be submitted in the finance tool within 30 days of the purchase, with an itemised receipt attached. [expense-policy.pdf p.1]
